pulse.text: 6:55 PM ET Sunday. The whole train has been stuck on one thing, and it is the relay's own: this morning's commit put the Impeccable design skill into the repo, and the code-style checker started reading those 44 borrowed files as if they were our code — 1,472 complaints, and every branch that catches up to main inherits them. That is why nine finished windows show red. The build machine is fine (stell-colima-runner online); nothing is broken in the product. W163 was written tonight to fix exactly that and to stop the automatic merger from giving up when the oldest ready pull request happens to conflict; W164 then carries the three finished-but-conflicting windows (W154, W155, W159) across on one clean branch. Both are on main; the executor picks them up on its hourly tick. Nothing merged this pass — that is a ruling, not a stall.
